updated_problem_understanding: The disappearance of writes was largely due to weak transaction concerns; however, duplicate or confusing effects now appear after ambiguous transaction errors and retries during network issues, suggesting the retry logic itself may be problematic.

strengthened: Explicit strong transaction concerns reduce missing writes.
weakened: Weak transaction concerns were the primary cause of missing writes.
still_active: Ambiguous transaction errors and retry handling may cause duplicate or confusing effects during network issues.

next_check: Instrument the retry logic to log the transaction state before each retry and verify that retries do not reapply writes that were already committed.
why_this_check_now: Duplicate/confusing behavior occurs after ambiguous transaction errors and retries, so inspecting the retry path will reveal whether it is reapplying committed writes or otherwise causing inconsistencies.

result_interpretation.supports_primary_if: Logs show that retries reapply writes that were already committed, confirming that retry handling is the cause of the duplicate/confusing effects.
result_interpretation.supports_competing_if: Logs show retries are idempotent and no duplicate writes occur, indicating another factor (e.g., network partition affecting read consistency) may be responsible.
